title: Electric Demolition Hammer 1500W, Heavy Duty SOL-100A,1800 RPM Copper Armature With 2 pcs Chisel, 21kg Weight Concrete Breaker Hilti for Construction sites (73 x 30 x 17cm)
description: A demolition hammer is a powerful, heavy-duty tool designed for breaking through tough materials such as concrete, brick, asphalt, and stone. It delivers high-impact force through a chisel or pointed bit, making it ideal for demolition, construction, and renovation projects. Unlike standard hammers, a demolition hammer is specifically engineered to provide maximum impact with minimal user effort, enabling efficient breaking and removal of hard surfaces. Construction workers and contractors commonly use this tool for tasks like tearing down walls, breaking up pavements, and removing old structures.
